UserStash.title: UserStash
UserStash.description: Cloud-synced Outpost Zero survival stash, unlocked armory, ammo, and crafting resource counts per authenticated player.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

callsign.description: Active operator callsign displayed on market listings.

credits.description: Player credit balance for market purchases and operator buy-backs.

maxPantsLevel.description: Highest unlocked Cargo Pants level (1 to 4 Safe Pockets).

unlockedWeaponKeys.description: Unlocked weapon identifiers owned in the Outpost armory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial stash creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last stash update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MarketListing.title: MarketListing
MarketListing.description: Live player-built marketplace listing for crafted weapons, cargo pants, medical supplies, base materials, or CDs.

sellerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who posted the listing.

sellerCallsign.description: Seller callsign shown in the live market feed.

buyerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the buyer once sold, or empty string while active.

itemName.description: Display name of the listed item.

itemDetail.description: Short tactical description or effect summary.

rarityLabel.description: Item rarity label displayed in the market and 3D inspector.

weaponKey.description: Weapon key when category is WEAPON, or empty string.

materialKey.description: Material key when category is MATERIAL, or empty string.

cdId.description: CD catalog number (1-150) when category is CD, or 0.

pantsLevel.description: Cargo pants level (1-4) when category is PANTS, or 0.

value.description: Restore power or base value of the listed item.

quantity.description: Number of units included in this listing.

priceCredits.description: Player-set sale price in Outpost Credits.

payoutClaimed.description: Whether the seller has collected sale credits after SOLD.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of listing creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest listing transition via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FieldNote.title: FieldNote
FieldNote.description: Player-authored survival and tactical notes persisted per user under Outpost Zero Notes Mode.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning player.

title.description: Short headline for the note (can be empty if untitled).

body.description: Main note content entered by the player.

category.description: Tactical tag category for filtering notes.

locationStamp.description: Optional in-game zone and floor stamp when note was recorded.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the logbook.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of note creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest note edit via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

KillFeedEvent.title: KillFeedEvent
KillFeedEvent.description: Live PvP combat kill feed event showing which player killed which player and with what weapon.

killerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the victorious operator.

killerCallsign.description: Callsign of the player who scored the kill.

victimId.description: Unique UID or rival ID of the eliminated player.

victimCallsign.description: Callsign of the player who was killed.

weaponKey.description: WeaponId key used in the elimination.

weaponName.description: Weapon display name shown in the live kill feed.

zoneName.description: Oakridge sector or building where the kill occurred.

feedScope.description: Broadcast scope for the live server-wide PvP kill feed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the kill event via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user's Outpost Zero cloud stash, crafting resources, and credits.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Private tactical field notes owned by the authenticated player.

/kill_feed/{eventId}.description: Real-time shared PvP kill feed broadcast across all players.
